Analysis: The spreadsheet library is now available in a temporary directory. Ready to write and verify the final workbook.

arguments.keystrokes:
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/report-libs python - <<'PY'
import mailbox,email.policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
from email.utils import parsedate_to_datetime,parseaddr
from openpyxl import Workbook,load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font,PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
p='/app/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/Mail/Local Folders/daily'
messages=list(mailbox.mbox(p,factory=lambda f: BytesParser(policy=email.policy.default).parse(f)))
messages=[m for m in messages if not (int(m.get('X-Mozilla-Status','0000'),16)&8)]
messages.sort(key=lambda m:parsedate_to_datetime(m['Date']).timestamp())
w=Workbook(); s=w.active; s.title='daily'
s.append(['sender_name','sender_address','subject','CC','number_of_attachments'])
for m in messages[-5:]:
 name,address=parseaddr(str(m['From']))
 cc=', '.join(str(h) for h in m.get_all('Cc',[]))
 attachments=sum(1 for part in m.walk() if part.get_content_disposition()=='attachment' or (part.get_filename() is not None and part.get_content_disposition()!='inline'))
 s.append([name,address,str(m['Subject']),cc,attachments])
for c in s[1]:
 c.font=Font(bold=True,color='FFFFFF'); c.fill=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='305496')
for i,width in enumerate([34,37,43,36,25],1): s.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width=width
s.freeze_panes='A2'; s.auto_filter.ref=s.dimensions
w.save('/app/report.xlsx')
r=load_workbook('/app/report.xlsx'); assert r.active.max_row==6 and r.active.max_column==5
for row in r.active.values: print(row)
PY
rm -rf /tmp/report-libs
ls -l /app/report.xlsx
